title: dimorphocalyx muricatus var. minor
intro: Dimorphocalyx muricatus var. minor, commonly known as the dwarf form of the Dimorphocalyx muricatus plant, is a species of plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is a type of medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, for its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Dimorphocalyx muricatus var. minor include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, contributing to its use in treating various health conditions including fever, wounds, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine, highlighting its potential in developing new treatments for various diseases.
